scope: Source-derived recipe content retains each record licence/attribution/source revision. UI code is separate original presentation code.
changes: Fields selected and serialized for static browsing; no images, media, source archives or original full-text containers; quantities remain source-qualified. No endorsement implied.
attribution: Per-record attribution, licence URI, original source URL, revision/history and original change notices retained. limitation: Licence labels and original-source qualification are inherited from held records, not independent new legal/culinary certification. Incomplete OCR/schema-example fixtures excluded; no dietary/allergen/health/origin claim.
